name: n8n
description: Workflow automation tool — open source alternative to Zapier/Make

env_vars.description: Encrypts the credentials n8n stores (auto-generated). Back it up: without this key a restored volume cannot decrypt them.
Set to false when behind a reverse proxy (required for domain linking)

post_install_notes: n8n is starting. The first visit to the web UI creates the owner account — do it before anyone else can reach the port. n8n 1.x has no basic authentication; accounts are managed inside the app. Workflows, credentials and the SQLite database live on the data volume, and the credentials on it are encrypted with N8N_ENCRYPTION_KEY, so keep a copy of that key with your backups. When you link a domain, set N8N_PROTOCOL to https and keep N8N_SECURE_COOKIE off only while you reach n8n over plain http.

credential_patterns.value: Create the owner account on first visit
